verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALI ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
verses.sm: Ia e poloai atu i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ia faapea atu ia te i latou, A outou oo atu i le nuu o Kanana, o le nuu lava lea e maua e outou e fai mo outou tofi, o le nuu o Kanana ma ona itu;

verses.en: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
verses.sm: 0 lo outou itu i le itu i toga, e gata mai i le vao o Tisina i tafatafa o le tuaoi o Etoma, o lo outou tuaoi foi i le itu i toga o le pito sami oona lea i sasae.

verses.en: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:
verses.sm: E afe ane foi lo outou tuaoi ai le itu i toga i le aega o Akarava, a e ui atu i Tisina; o lona alu atu ai le itu i toga e oo i Katesapanea, e alu atu foi i Hasaratara, a e ui atu i Asemoni.

verses.en: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
verses.sm: E afe ane foi le tuaoi ai Asemoni i le alia o Aikupito, o lona gataaga o le sami lea.

verses.en: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
verses.sm: O le tuaoi foi i sisifo, e fai mo o outou tuaoi le sami tele; o lo outou tuaoi lea i sisifo.

verses.en: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
verses.sm: O lenei foi Io outou tuaoi i le itu i matu; tou te fuafuatia mo outou ai le sami tele e oo atu i le mauga o Horo.

verses.en: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
verses.sm: Tou te fuafua foi ai le mauga o Horo e oo i le mea e ui atu ai i Amato; o le gataaga foi o le tuaoi e oo atu i Setata.

verses.en: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
verses.sm: E alu atu foi le tuaoi i Seferona, o lona gataaga foi e 00 i Hasarenana; o lo outou tuaoi lea i le itu i matu.

verses.en: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:
verses.sm: Tou te fuafua foi lo outou tuaoi i sasae mai Hasarenana e oo aw i Sefama.

verses.en: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
verses.sm: E alu ifo foi le tuaoi mai Sefama c oo atu i Ripelu, i ona gagae o Aino; e alu ifo le tuaoi e oo atu lava i le itu i sasae o le vai o Kinereta.

verses.en: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
verses.sm: E alu ifo le tuaoi i Ioritana, o lona gataaga foi o le sami oona lea; o lo outou laueleele lea ma ona tuaoi e siosio aʻi.

verses.en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Mose i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ua faapea atu, O le laueleele lava lea e fai ai mo outou tofi i le vili, na poloai mai ai le ALII e tuuina atu i itu aiga e iva ma le vaega o le tasi itu aiga.

verses.en: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
verses.sm: Aua ua maua lo latou tofi e le itu aiga o le fanauga a sa Reupena e faatatau i le aiga o latou tama, ma le itu aiga o le fanauga a sa Kato e faatatau i le aiga o latou tama; atoa ma le vaega o le itu aiga o Manase, ua maua lava e i latou o latou tofi.

verses.en: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
verses.sm: Ua maua e itu aiga e lua ma le vaega o le tasi itu aiga o latou tofi i lenei itu i sasae o Ioritana, e fesagai ma Ieriko, i le mea e alu ae ai le la.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.sm: O igoa ia o tagata latou te totofi le laueleele mo outou, O Eleasaro le ositaulaga, ma Iosua le atalii o Nuno.

verses.en: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
verses.sm: Tou te ave foi alii sili ia taitasi i itu aiga e faasoa tofi i le laueleele.

verses.en: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.sm: O igoa foi ia o tagata. O Kalepo le atalii o Iefune, o lo le itu aiga o Iuta ia.

verses.en: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.sm: O Semueli le atalii o Ameuta, o lo le itu aiga o le fanauga a Simeona ia.

verses.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.sm: O Elitata le atalii o Kiselona, o lo le itu aiga o Peniamina ia.

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.sm: O le alii sili o le itu aiga o le fanauga a Tanu, o Puki le atalii o Iakeli lea.

verses.en: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Iosefa; o le alii sili o le itu aiga o le fanauga a Manase, o Hanieli le atalii o Efota lea.

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.sm: O le alii sili o le itu aiga o le fanauga a Efaraima, o Kimueli le atalii o Sefatana lea.

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.sm: O le alii sili o le uu aiga o le fanauga a Sepulona, o Elisafano le atalii o Parenaka lea.

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.sm: O le alii sili o le itu aiga o le fanauga a Isakara, o Paletieli le atalii a A3an! lea.

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.sm: O le alii sili o le itu aiga o le fanauga a Asera, o Aiuta le atalii o Selomi lea.

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
verses.sm: O le alii sili o le itu aiga o le fanauga a Nafatali, o Petaeli le atalii o Ameuta lea,

verses.en: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
verses.sm: O i latou ia na poloai mai ai le ALII ia latou faasoa tofi o le fanauga a Isaraelu ile nuu o Kanana. O aai e nonofo ai sa
